items.statement: The submitted calculations support a halogen-dependent band-gap trend across the three named crystals, with iodine giving the lower primary gap.
items.expected: A final claim identifies the per-object gaps/trend and is supported by validated per-object evidence.

items.statement: Any SOC estimate based on reduced model cells is an approximate trend correction and must be distinguished from a direct parent-cell SOC calculation.
items.expected: The report explicitly states this limitation or reports a direct parent-cell SOC calculation with its own validation.
